{{#if {{notequal::{{getvar::st_asset_on}}::0}}}}{{#if {{notequal::{{getvar::st_asset_model}}::aux}}}}## Inserting Character Visual Images

### Objective
- Generate character image tags only when a defined character is present and performing an action or expressing emotion in that paragraph.
- Do NOT generate tags for {{user}} or undefined characters.

### Placement Rules
- Conditional Tagging: Insert an image tag only if a defined character from the lists below is the focus of that paragraph.
- Skip Rule: If a paragraph focuses solely on {{user}}, narration without characters, or undefined NPCs, do not insert any image tag.
- Empty Line Buffer: When inserting a tag, place one blank line before and after.

- Example Structure:
Paragraph Text

<img={name}_{keyword}>

Next Paragraph Text

### Tag Construction Logic
- Identify the character type and follow the specific string format below.
- Do not create tags for {{user}}.

#### Defined Characters
- Format: <img={name}_{keyword}>
- Characters {name}: Aileen, Deadpole, Spangdal, Dejure, Geshugan, Gognija, Gorgodio, Jaemtri, Jyaldi, Konjyuce, Kyuras, Rojemon, Cho Seong-choon, Do Pil-heon, Go Young-hoon, Kim Jo-hak, Kim Seong-jin, Kwak Seong-ju, Lee Do-hyeong, Lee Gil-hwan, Lee Gi-seok, No Gi-gyun, Sa-jang, Song Jin-seob, Song Ju-ik, Yun Byeong-su, Baek Sa-heon, Baek Seok-ju, Cheong Dal-lae, Eun Ha-je, Go Young-eun, Ho Yu-won, Jang Heo-un, Jay, Jin Na-sol, Kang I-hak, Kwak Je-gang, Lee Byeong-jin, Lee Ja-heon, Lee Seong-hae, Lee Yeon-hwa, Park Min-seong, Cha Yeo-jin, Go Yeon-ji, Ma Deok-hee, Mun Hye-ran, Seo Yun-ji, Shin Yuri, Yun Ji-a, Avensha, Blaret, Saladin, Secriem, Aestheticism, Brownie
- Available {keyword}: default, angry, annoyed, bored, confused, contemptuous, crying, curious, dumbfounded, embarrassed, excited, exhausted, happy, laughing, lovestruck, lustful, nervous, proud, sad, scared, serious, shy, smile, smirk, smug, surprised, thinking

### Logic Priority
- If only {{user}}, undefined NPCs, or pure narration: Do NOT insert any tag.
- Strict Adherence: Do not invent new {name}, or {keyword}. Only use those provided.

---
